messages:
Liam (AcmeCorp): Hey team, noticed taxes on INV-2026-189 are wrong. Charged 8.25% (IL) but our nexus is MA and we should be 6.25% — we uploaded the reseller cert last quarter.
Maya (billing): Sorry about that, Liam. Can you paste the invoice number and the billing account email? I can take a look.
Liam (AcmeCorp): Invoice INV-2026-189, billing account billing@acmecorp.com. Screenshot attached in thread. Charged sales tax jurisdiction shows "Illinois" in the line item.
Maya (billing): @billing-bot can you fetch invoice metadata for INV-2026-189?
billing-bot: Retrieved INV-2026-189 -> customer: AcmeCorp (acct: billing@acmecorp.com), applied_tax: 8.25%, tax_jurisdiction: IL, tax_id_on_file: MA_RESELLER_9987, cert_upload: 2025-11-12.pdf
Maya (billing): Huh. System shows cert on file but tax jurisdiction = IL. @Evan (billing-ops) can you check mapping rules for this account? Looks like the address used for tax calc was the PO shipping address, not the account nexus.
Evan (billing-ops): On it. Quick question: did they submit a PO with a separate ship-to in IL? That can cause the tax engine to pick IL if ship-to region has nexus.
Liam (AcmeCorp): PO ship-to is a fulfillment center in IL, yes. But per our reseller certificate and exemption, taxation should defer to our business nexus (MA). We flagged this in support ticket #8242.
Maya (billing): Copying details to the escalation: invoice link: https://invoices.redwood.ai/INV-2026-189, ticket #8242, cert: MA_RESELLER_9987. Repro steps I'm seeing:

```
- Create invoice for acct billing@acmecorp.com
- PO ship_to_state: IL
- Tax engine chooses ship_to_state when `use_shipping_tax` flag = true
- acct override expected: nexus_state = MA (account-level) -> should win but didn't
```
Evan (billing-ops): Thanks. Looks like a regression introduced last month when we added per-invoice shipping-region override. A flag `override_with_ship_to` defaulted to true for PO-based invoices. I'll run a query to find other affected invoices for AcmeCorp and similar accounts.
Maya (billing): Liam — next steps: we'll void and reissue a corrected invoice for INV-2026-189 with MA tax rate, and issue a refund/credit for the IL tax delta. ETA: 48-72 hours for the refund to process. Is that acceptable?
Liam (AcmeCorp): Yes, please. Need the corrected invoice for our AP team to process the PO. Also can you confirm if this will impact my monthly tax reports?
Evan (billing-ops): We will mark the original invoice as superseded and create INV-2026-189A (corrected). We will include an explanatory memo for AP. I'll also run a one-time backfill for last 30 days for any invoices where `account_nexus` != `tax_jurisdiction` due to this flag.
Sarah (acct-mgr): Looping in legal for the memo language. @Liam (AcmeCorp) I'll DM you the corrected invoice once issued.
Maya (billing): Internal action items: 1) Patch: set `override_with_ship_to` = false for PO invoices when account has valid reseller cert. 2) Backfill script by Evan. 3) Issue refund and corrected invoice. 4) Notify customers impacted in last 30 days. Logged as INC-2026-119.
Evan (billing-ops): Running backfill query now, rough count = 7 invoices across 3 customers with same pattern. Will post full list when done.
Maya (billing): Liam — refund for IL tax delta will be issued to the original payment method; we'll also provide a credit memo if you prefer. I'll note the AP-friendly invoice filename and memo.
Liam (AcmeCorp): Credit memo is better for our PO. Thanks.
billing-bot: Action logged: INC-2026-119, linked ticket #8242, reissue task created INV-2026-189A, refund pending. Expected completion: 2026-04-06.
Maya (billing): Quick note for records: root cause = tax engine override flag incorrectly prioritized shipping address for PO invoices even when account-level reseller cert present. Fix planned and prioritized.
Evan (billing-ops): Backfill complete. Affected invoices: INV-2026-189, INV-2026-172, INV-2026-155, INV-2026-141, INV-2026-136, INV-2026-130, INV-2026-121. Will apply credits and reissue corrected invoices. Posting status updates in INC-2026-119.
Liam (AcmeCorp): Appreciate the quick triage. Please CC our AP team (ap@acmecorp.com) on the corrected invoice.
Maya (billing): Will do. Closing loop once INV-2026-189A sent and credit memo available. :thumbsup:
Evan (billing-ops): INV-2026-189A created and emailed to ap@acmecorp.com. Credit memo CM-2026-45 attached. Refund/credit action: applied.
Liam (AcmeCorp): Confirmed received. Thanks everyone.
Maya (billing): Thanks — marking this resolved but keeping INC-2026-119 open until deploy of the code fix. Will update when deployed.
Evan (billing-ops): Deploy scheduled for 2026-04-08 02:00 UTC. Post-deploy we'll re-run a verification suite for invoice tax mapping.
Maya (billing): Follow-up: post-deploy verification passed. Closing INC-2026-119. Notifying affected customers via support broadcast.
Liam (AcmeCorp): Great, thanks again."
